This is intended to help others make decisions. My wife purchased a Keurig K450 coffee maker direct from Keurig in June 2017. I bought this refillable pod shortly thereafter. I wanted to use to to fill my 20 ounce Contigo travel mug each morning. Here are my results.
1. The pod worked perfectly fine with the Keurig menu. When using the pod, I get the full Keurig 2.0 menu.
2. Yes, the pod will allow some very very fine grounds to get into the brewed coffee. These are so finae and so few that they're a very minor nuisance to me...i.e. no big deal at all to me.
3. The pod alone will not allow you to choose/use the carafe options. In order to do this, you must also have a Keurig carafe or trick the unit with a magnet. By using the magnet trick, I found that even the smallest carafe setting of 2-3 cups was just a tiny bit too much liquid for my 20 ounce Contigo mug. So bottom line, even if I readily had access to the all of the carafe options using this pod, they wouldn't work well for my Contigo mug.
4. To fill my 20ounce Contigo mug, I simply choose option 2 and select a 16 ounce brew. When that completes, I open/close the pod chamber and then choose option 4 and make a small 4 ounce brew. This gives me a nice full 20 ounce brew. Yes, it's a nuisance to have to do the brew in two cycles, but it's a minor nuisance.

Recently I picked up some new gaming equipment and I was a little worried about the cords that shipped with it. They seemed flimsy and as I thought at the time I ordered it, they arrived about 12 feet way too short!
After a quick check around Amazon, I located this product which seemed to have everything I needed. I can confirm that it works both with the HDMI 2.0 and the 4K set ups, as well as working with regular HDMI and (surprisingly!) a 3D set up. I ended up switching this cable out for the standard HDMI I got from another product and I could not have been happier.
No loss of frame rate, even with 4K, clear, sharp images and sound, worked like a dream. I will probably order another few cables when I switch around a few TVs and also pick one up for my tablet/laptop/mobile networking when I'm away from home. The cord coils up beautifully every time and the gold tipped connectors look like the kind that will last quite a while even when being plugged and unplugged more than normal.

The BEST PART about these cables though is the thickness! If you hate wires that seem flimsy or like they could snap at any moment, this is a winner. I was so happy to see they were truly braided, covered and look pretty tough. If you have pets who have a habit of chewing (as I do) this can be a deal breaker! I am pleased to say they are thick enough not to be a temptation, and even at the few test bite places looks no worse for wear. I think these were a great value for the
